sources.label: Independent, clean-room Morphe patch bundle, built for multiple applications. Tw
sources.author: Kero309x
patch_list: Allow screenshots
Stops the app hiding its screens from screenshots and screen recordings.
Disable certificate pinning
Stops the app refusing servers whose certificate is not one of its two pinned keys.
Disable the forced update requirement
Stops the client from blocking the app, or opening the store, when the server marks this build as outdated.
Disable usage tracking
Stops the app reporting its usage, social-media, survey and experiment events.
Hide the promotional card
Stops the home, recharge and payment screens from drawing the promotional gift card.
Ignore the server's remote wipe and forced logout
Stops a silent push from clearing the app's data or logging the account out.
Keep the password of each account
Stops the app forgetting the password of an account, so it stops asking for it every time.
Remove the saved account limit
Lets the app keep more than five accounts and switch between all of them.
Skip the store licence check
Stops the bundled licence client from validating the installation before the application starts.
Use the current connection for Vodafone Cash
Lets the Vodafone Cash service use the connection the device already has, instead of asking for mobile data.
